look: Shardling Sprout, a F-rank GKOM variant from the Shardlings family: knee-high crystal-budded sapling waddling on root feet. Family anatomy: living saplings and trees of bark and roots with crystal buds and geode hollows. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: only a few small GKOM crystal growths (two or three finger-length points); most of its natural skin, hide or surface is exposed; the crystals are pale green quartz. A marble-sized GKOM core orb, murky grey, dim faint pulse, is embedded visibly in its chest or body centre. Element Earth: amber, moss green and slate accents, tiny subtle stone shards, crystal dust and drifting petals
